newsitem.title: BRAZIL: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BRAZIL, Sept 17 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 malt discharger, 1 sugar loader, 1 container/general cargo discharger/loader, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 steel products/granite, 2 cellulose loaders. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 1 Steel plates loader. Ubu - 2 Iron ore loaders, 14 vessels due. Santos - The casual port labourers strike which commenced on 2/9 from 1900 hours, ended on 11/9 when labour decided to resume work. Vessels berthed - 5 Full containers, 2 general cargo/containers, 2 bulk cement dischargers, 17 sugar loaders, 1 chemical products, 4 wheat dischargers, 4 fertiliser dischargers, 2 gasoline loaders, 1 bulk pellets loader, 1 coal loader, 1 salt discharger. 35 Vessels waiting in roads, 96 due during next 7 days.

Cosipa - 1 Steel products loader, 1 iron ore discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 3 bulk fertiliser, 3 full containers, 1 soya loader, 1 wheat discharger, 1 soya oil loader. 7 Vessels waiting in roads, 23 due. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 4 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - 1 Vessel berthed, 3 waiting in roads, 6 due. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 container discharger, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 oil discharger, 1 paper discharger, 1 sugar loader, 1 steel products loaders. Tecon - 36 Vessels due during next 7 days.

CHILE, Sept 17 - Arica - Nine vessels due, all vessels should berth on arrival, no swell. Iquique - 11 Vessels due. Some minor congestion expected due to 2 piers still out of service until beginning of October. Antofagasta - Eight vessels due, no congestion expected. Valparaiso - 16 Vessels due, no waiting time expected. San Antonio - 14 vessels due, some minor congestion expected on 19/9 when 6 vessels will arrive. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - Busy from 19/9 to 25/9. San Vicente - Busy from 18/9 to 26/9, some waiting time in roads is expected. Steel pier - 2 Vessels operating at north pier, south pier available. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel operating. Lirquen - Four vessels operating, no waiting time expected. Puerto Montt - Punta Arenas - Working normally.

PERU, Sept 16 - Callao - Five vessels in bay, 5 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One vessel in bay, 2 in pier (fishmeal/general cargo), no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - Two fishmeal vessels in bay, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Sept 16 - Puerto Cabello - Three vessels anchored. 10 Vessels berthed of which 4 grain, 3 general cargo, 1 ro/ro, 2 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Three vessels anchored, 4 grain berthed. Sept 17 - Orinoco River - Draft 37 ft. 6 in. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels loading iron ore, 6 due. Palua - One vessel loading briquettes, 1 due. Boca Grande - Two vessels loading iron ore. MI 178 - Three vessels waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. Matanzas - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 6 Vessels operating of which 5 loading steel products, 1 discharging scrap. 2 Vessels due. Venalum - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 2 loading aluminium.

Alcasa - Two vessels discharging coke. Interalumina - One vessel due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium, 1 due. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel due. Puerto Cabello - Three vessels waiting at anchorage load/discharge. 16 Vessels operating of which 12 loading/discharging generals, 3 discharging grain, 1 discharging sugar. 16 Vessels due. Maracaibo - Two vessels loading/discharging generals. Puerto Miranda - Two vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - Five vessels loading urea. Buoy B71 - One vessel loading coal. San Francisco - Two vessels loading crude oil. La Ceiba - Two vessels loading coal. Palmarejo Sur, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, Bajo Grande - No vessels. Guanta - Four vessels operating of which 1 each discharging barytes, bentonite, salt. 1 Loading aluminium, 2 vessels due. Amuay - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. Cardon - Three vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Guaranao - One vessel discharging woodpulp. La Guaira - Four vessels loading/discharging generals. 5 Vessels due, 3 under repair. All ports working normally.
